8420 paurāṇa 'relating to the past, ancient' MBh. [purāṇá-]
    Pa. pōrāṇa-, °aka- 'ancient', Aś. porāṇā f. sg., Pk. pōrāṇa-, Ko. porno; Si. poraṇa 'ancient', puraṇa 'fallow or waste land, land where crop has been reaped'.
